2116720122878362096.en_summary: $GNRC CEO states Generac's data center generator backlog nearly tripled to $4.5B after landmark long-term agreement with Amazon. Initial deliveries expected $2.4B combined in 2027 and 2028, nearly tripling backlog from 90 days ago.
2116720122878362096.zh_summary: $GNRC 執行長表示，Generac 的資料中心發電機訂單積壓在與亞馬遜簽訂里程碑式長期協議後幾乎增加三倍至 45 億美元。2027 及 2028 年預計初始交付合計 24 億美元，訂單積壓較 90 天前幾乎增加三倍。

2116729592249561380.en_summary: AI selloff is about cash flow, financing cost and waiting for returns, not demand evaporating. Demand remains strong: SK hynix Q3 revenue 104.6T won (+328% YoY), OP 83.3T with ~80% margin, DRAM/HBM sold out through 2029. Anthropic unit economics improving sharply, first quarterly OP. Hyperscalers Amazon, Alphabet, Meta maintain or raise 2026 capex, still leaving demand unmet. Market focuses on negative FCF and financing gap. NASDAQ trailing PE high-20s vs 190x in 2000.
2116729592249561380.zh_summary: AI 拋售是關於現金流、融資成本及等待回報的時間，而非需求消失。需求依然強勁：SK hynix 第三季營收 104.6 兆韓元（同比 +328%），營業利潤 83.3 兆韓元，利潤率約 80%，DRAM/HBM 至 2029 年售罄。Anthropic 單位經濟大幅改善，首次季度營業利潤。超大規模業者 Amazon、Alphabet、Meta 維持或上調 2026 年資本支出，仍無法滿足全部需求。市場關注負自由現金流及融資缺口。納斯達克追蹤市盈率處於二十幾倍，對比 2000 年的 190 倍。

2116526876130672839.en_summary: JOJO.Index = ATAC Credit-On/Credit-Off Index, launched 6/14/2021. Results before launch are backtested and hypothetical. Indexes are unmanaged, have no fees and cannot be invested in directly. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Not investment advice.
2116526876130672839.zh_summary: JOJO.Index = ATAC 信用開啟/關閉指數，於 2021 年 6 月 14 日推出。推出前結果為回測及假設。指數非管理型，無費用，不能直接投資。過去表現不保證未來結果。非投資建議。

2116526873966424252.en_summary: 281 weeks since June 2021 launch. 81 regime flips. Credit-off 47% of the time. In 132 credit-off weeks: JOJO.Index -0.106%, high yield +0.063%. In 148 credit-on weeks: index +0.067%, long Treasuries -0.133%. Live, being defensive has had a cost.
2116526873966424252.zh_summary: 自 2021 年 6 月推出以來 281 週。81 次制度轉換。信用關閉佔 47% 時間。132 個信用關閉週：JOJO.Index -0.106%，高收益 +0.063%。148 個信用開啟週：指數 +0.067%，長期國債 -0.133%。實盤中，防禦策略已產生成本。
